[quote=british_calradia;60873556]Mr X takes a quick glance at the offer of the treaty 

He is impressed by the good standards of the Sikirksian medical industry, it's quality of Mercenaries and Arms Industry. It is passed around the delegation team and it equally recieves great praise by the rest and with this consencus a return offer is made.

"Vice-President, this is one mighty offer you have. We are impressed"

"We would like to offer a return trade in exchange for medical and arms stuff and usage of your mercenaries - for our frontier regions to quell resistance, we would like to provide Oil and Gas resources, Automobile industry related items, Transportation related items and the Imperial Broadcasting Corporation to set up a local branch to provide reliable news"

As soon as Mr X finishes and before the Sikirskians could reply, a "ahem" could be heard from a member of New Balion's delegation. Everyone turns their heads towards the [i]interesting[/i] man, known as Mr G. Quagmire; 

"You're forgetting the most important thing! WOMEN!!"
"In exchange for sending our beauties over to Sikirsk, we can have some of your local women come over to us!"
"After all, we there is a new for more immigrants to settle our frontiers as well as more people in our modelling and cosmetics industries. Ciggity Ciggity"

Mr G. Quagmire then proceeds to leave the room, presumably to "hunt" something down. The rest of New Balion delegation nod their heads and then Mr X remembers the last part of the Vice-President's words.

"Vice-President, I hate to break it to you but....... our old Empire including lands that were apart of Shamat. This includes descendants of ethnic Balion Nancestry whom lands range from small fishing towns to large provinces. We hope they re-join our Empire as it is best for them to be apart of a nation that is ethnically close to them"[/quote]

Well Well Well, interesting.

Guhhh, someone, please go get that guy. Take him to floor B when you've gotten him. 

[i]Two guards enter the room, while the guard who already were inside the room pick up their rifles and leave the room.[/i]

Vice President: Mr X, this looks all good and well, but you must understand, Sikirsk simply can't accept any form of external influences on our continent. We do not care where it comes from. 

We can easily agree on your other terms. Except the two odd ones out.

[i][b]The Vice President lays out a map showing both nations.[/b][/i]

Can we continue, or not? 

-----------------------------------------------

Mr X responds with "We shall"

"Lets discuss the potential specific routes between our cities and ports. As you can see, since a lot of our urban centres are coastal or close to the coast, we have a plethora of cities for you to choose from when it comes to importing stuff. And on top of that if companies from your nation wish to go international in their products, they can easily set up factories and depots within our nation due to the low labour costs, abundant workers and easy access to international waters.

As well, I propose loosening immigration restrictions between our peoples. Especially since we need our frontiers filled and the model/talent industries to be filled with new models of an "exotic" kind which will do wonders for your peoples internationally."

As the round goes between each of the NBE's delegation offering their solutions and ideas, Mr G. Quagmire is on his own adventure. Somehow he managed to escape the building and quickly have a rendezvous with two local women in a bedroom in a apartment somewhere in the city that these talks are happening. As the security guards are on chase for Mr G. Quagmire, they follow the path of scores of crying women who report to them that the first thing they saw him do is "move in a funny way" and "say Ciggity Ciggity" over and over. 

As Mr G. Quagmire is now long gone, the delegation suggest to the Vice-President that; "You should let him be, he really is a harmless man. Just very eccentric".

As that chaos is unfolding, the talks quickly turn back towards more serious matters. The issue over Shamatan influence is complicated. It is noted that the NBE is a great supporter of the state of Mizrahel and as mentioned, if the will of the Ex/New Balionites on Shamat is towards joining the Empire, then it must be respected.

OOC: Please do not kill Mr G. Quagmire! He will be very vital in my future RPs

[quote=veladyn;60813634]"Perfect." the King said, returning the smile. "Let me signal the guard to bring the photographer in the room." He pressed the button on the table, and the guard walked in, bowing. "Bring the royal photographer in, please." the King said to him. "Certainly sir. Is there anything else?" "Now that you mention it, there is. Bring in some tea for the Eneas Diplomatic Envoy group, if you don't mind." "Not a problem, Your Majesty, it shall be tended to right away."

Before long, the royal photographer and a royal server walked in bringing the camera on its stand and the tea. After they set everything in place, they both bowed. "For His Majesty the King and their excellencies." the server said, speaking gently, before leaving the room promptly. 

"If His Majesty and Sir Walter Sarsen could be the only ones in the first photo." the photographer said. The King motioned to his personal secretary to walk with them just out the camera's range. "Perfect. Now if the King and the diplomatic envoy could shake hands." The picture was taken, and the photographer spoke once again. "Now, if the diplomatic envoy's group could come into the picture with the King's personal secretary. Oh, and if the King's personal secretary could go to the left of the King and the diplomatic envoy to the right. Alright, now if the Secretary of the Minister of Foreign Affairs could go the left of the Diplomatic Envoy and the Representative of the Prince's Personal Staff go to the right of the King's personal secretary. Splendid." With that, the second picture was taken.

The King moved to the table and sat down, signing the document confirming Eneas' accession to the Non-Aligned Bloc. He then handed the pen to his personal secretary, who signed the document as a witness. His personal secretary then handed the pen to Sir Walter Sarsen.[/quote]

Sarsen was given an encouraging, or withering, glare from the other two as he was gestured to stand diplomatically next to the King for the first pictures and the handshake with a bright smile. Before they were taken the other two sipped the tea, although Sir Melville took short sips only, before they took the right positions for the second pictures, with the Secretary with his hands on his front, and  the representative held the trim of his suit.

Sir Walter would then go on to follow the King, and sign the document, when the representative passed him down a small golden cylinder, which Sir Walter unscrewed to show a red stamp, with the seal of the Prince, which he stamped right next to his signature. After that he'd offer to shake the King's Hand one last time as Sir Melville took the golden cylinder and screwed it back shut.

"It's been an honour, your royal Highness. We hope for a long and harmonious link between our nations." Walter said.
